environment.description: Bare-metal Debian 12 host running the service as user 'diagsvc'. No MAC framework enabled (AppArmor removed during hardening to reduce attack surface per ops team decision). Service runs behind nginx reverse proxy with rate limiting only. The diagsvc user has standard POSIX permissions with read access to /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow (group shadow), and write access to /tmp.

config.network: nginx reverse proxy with rate limiting (10 req/s)
